build_vision_tower: build a VisionTower module with a frozen backbone and configurable head blocks for vision feature extraction
create_vision_head: create a VisionHead with self-attention blocks and SwiGLU FFN layers to process image tokens
build_vision_model_from_config: build a complete vision model from a backbone config file using build_vision_model
extract_backbone_features: extract class tokens, patch tokens, and register tokens from images using get_backbone_features
init_vision_tower_weights: initialize VisionTower weights using init_weights to apply ViT weight initialization to all blocks
